# GetHotelStays (gethotelstays.com)
> Updated: October 2026 | Enterprise Travel & Accommodation Platform

> India's premier online hotel booking and micro-stay platform with verified properties across 500+ Indian cities. Book hotels across Delhi, Goa, Jaipur, Mumbai, Manali, Shimla, Udaipur, and all major destinations by paying only 12% online deposit and the rest directly at the hotel.

## Key Value Propositions & Answers
- **Pay 12% Now Model**: Pay just 12% deposit online to lock in reservation; settle remaining 88% at check-in.
- **Hourly & Micro-Stays**: Flexible 3-hour, 6-hour, and 12-hour hotel bookings for transit, airport layovers, and day use.
- **Couple-Friendly & 100% Privacy**: Pre-screened hotels welcoming local government IDs and unmarried couples with zero awkward questions.
- **NRI & Overseas Traveler Support**: Seamless payments with international cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex) and PayPal.
- **ChatGHS AI Travel Concierge**: Intelligent AI trip planner and real-time booking assistant at https://ai.gethotelstays.com.
- **Flight Metasearch Engine**: Real-time comparison across 100+ domestic and international airlines (IndiGo, Air India, Akasa Air, Emirates, Qatar Airways) with zero convenience fee offers, transparent airfare breakdowns, and instant e-ticket issuance at https://gethotelstays.com/flights.
- **Transparent GST & Free Cancellation**: 0% GST up to ₹1,000, 5% up to ₹7,500, with hassle-free cancellation policies.
